observations.seen: Forest frame has a readable daylight key with soft fill. The wharf and ember frames are flat and monochrome orange-brown, with little key/fill separation on the characters.
Contact shadows under Pip and the blocky NPC are soft blobs that ground them weakly. The large foreground pine casts no visible shadow, and there is no clear sun-direction shadow in the ember scene.
Pip's acorn cap and the metal cage towers show almost no environment reflection. Surfaces read as uniformly diffuse, and the blue crystal portal lacks specular response.
Floating island platforms with a gate, windmill and pagoda give clear destinations. Ground planes are large, empty, untextured brown/green slabs. The wharf deck is a bare brown surface.
The ember level has floating spark particles and a warm haze. Distance fog in the forest is mild. The wharf sky is a flat grey overcast with little depth layering.
Low-poly pines carry visible noisy triangle texturing. The voxel NPC is unlit-looking flat color. Wood crates are decent. The ember floor is smeared flat brown with no material definition.

Pip is a charming, well-modeled character, and the gate, windmill and cage props are detailed. However, the Minecraft-style blocky companion clashes stylistically with the smooth hero and the faceted trees.

In frame 1 a blocky NPC sits dead center, occluding the hero's path, and a giant pine eats the right third. The NPC also crowds Pip in the other frames. Pip occupies roughly 10–15% of the frame, under the 18–25% target.
Camera is a behind-the-back chase cam, not the side-on follow the recipe calls for. In frame 1 foreground tree geometry clips in close to the lens.
Some bloom on the ember glows and a soft tone curve are visible. The wharf frame is low contrast and washed. Aliasing is visible on tree edges.
Pip is caught in a mid-stride run pose with reasonable limb extension. The NPC appears static and T-like.

The HUD has clean pill-shaped counters, hearts and an objective text box, plus a well-styled Atlas modal with a world grid. However, a dense top tab bar and a long controls string at the bottom clutter the screen.
